title: Parity Families of Lattice Paths and Real-Rooted Signed Eulerian Polynomials

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India; Formerly, University of Calcutta (Heramba Chandra College), Kolkata 700029, India

description:
We classify the extremal families of lattice paths with pairwise even numbers of common edges for every length and endpoint, which gives Shankar's Catalan conjecture, compute the binary rank of grid graphs, and double the lower bound for odd families in the square. We prove that the signed Eulerian polynomials are real-rooted, as Fulman, Kim, Lee and Petersen conjectured, and settle conjectures on canon, caged and Dumont permutations.

The archive contains the paper (paper/LatticePathsPaper.pdf), a Lean 4 certificate of its finite identities (lean/, 29 theorems, core library only, no axioms) and Julia programs that check every computed statement of the paper (julia/).
